environment.description: ECS Fargate task running with AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess managed policy. Container runs as root (default Fargate behavior without explicit user). SQS queue has no message validation or content filtering. The /var/spool/docprocessor/output directory is on the root filesystem with no mount namespace isolation. No AppArmor or seccomp profile applied. IAM role arn:arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/docprocessor-worker-role has no permission boundary.

config.filesystem: writable root filesystem, no read-only mount
